## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Related Issue

Closes #<number>. For expressly authorized work without an Issue, link the approved scope or explain the exception.

## Scope and architectural changes

Name affected modules, public contracts and ADRs. Explain material departures from the approved plan.

## Acceptance criteria and test evidence

Map criteria to evidence on the PR head. Record exact commands, outcomes and failures or omitted checks with reasons.

## Risks, limitations and manual verification

Record open risks and any owner-run checks, including prerequisites and expected results.

## Documentation updates

Name the changed documentation, or explain why current documentation remains accurate.
